stem.en: In our pile, one prompt has a single bar at full height, because Python's rules allow only one next token there. Which prompt is it?

explanation.en: After `for m`, the rules of Python allow only `in`, so all 7 lines agree. After `for m in` the bars lean towards `marks`, but other lists appear too. `print(` spreads across many tokens, and `each m among` has no lines at all.
